name: quantmod
resume: Added to the registry on user approval, as a reference for tseries get.hist.quote (its only use). Only getSymbols is inventoried. The Python port of get.hist.quote uses urllib directly (routing: HTTP requests), so getSymbols itself is not translated. The rest of quantmod is not opened. The installed R quantmod is a local stub (0.4.29, getSymbols not implemented). The real quantmod_0.4.29 tarball needs xts, TTR and curl, which are not in registry.json, so it is not installed.
